metadata.name: B2B SaaS Meeting Room Booking
metadata.product_idea: AI-powered meeting room booking system for enterprise offices
metadata.description: Golden set reference for B2B SaaS products with enterprise focus

state.product_idea: AI-powered meeting room booking system for enterprise offices that optimizes space utilization and reduces scheduling conflicts

executive_summary.tagline: Smart meeting room management for the modern enterprise
executive_summary.problem_statement: Enterprise offices waste 30-40% of meeting room capacity due to no-shows, phantom bookings, and inefficient scheduling. This costs companies thousands annually in underutilized real estate.
executive_summary.solution_overview: RoomSync uses AI to predict meeting patterns, automatically release unused rooms, and optimize space allocation across the enterprise with real-time occupancy sensing.
executive_summary.value_proposition: Reduce meeting room conflicts by 80% and increase space utilization by 40% with intelligent automation and predictive scheduling.
target_users: Office managers responsible for space planning
Executive assistants who book meeting rooms daily
executive_summary.target_market_size: TAM: $8.5B (global workplace management software). SAM: $2.1B (enterprise meeting room management). SOM: $210M (mid-market and enterprise in North America).
key_differentiators: Seamless calendar integration with all major platforms
executive_summary.competitive_landscape: Competing with Robin, Envoy, and Teem. Key differentiator is AI-first approach versus rule-based systems.
executive_summary.funding_required: $2.5M seed funding for product development and initial go-to-market over 18 months
executive_summary.revenue_model: SaaS subscription with per-seat pricing: $5/employee/month for Standard, $12/employee/month for Enterprise
executive_summary.financial_projections: Year 1: $500K ARR, 50 customers. Year 3: $5M ARR, 300 customers.
executive_summary.break_even_timeline: Month 24 with current burn rate and projected growth
executive_summary.expected_roi: 4x ROI by Year 3 based on enterprise deal expansion
top_risks: Enterprise sales cycle length (6-12 months) may delay revenue recognition
Integration complexity with legacy calendar systems
Competition from established workplace platforms adding similar features
executive_summary.regulatory_summary: GDPR and CCPA compliance required for employee data handling. SOC 2 Type II certification needed for enterprise sales.
executive_summary.gtm_strategy: Enterprise-focused sales motion with initial focus on tech companies in SF Bay Area, expand to finance and professional services.

key_decisions.decision: Build vs Buy occupancy sensing hardware
key_decisions.recommendation: Partner with existing IoT platform (e.g., Density) to accelerate time-to-market

segments_examined: Office managers at companies with 500+ employees
research_scope.observation_context: Conducted 12 customer interviews, analyzed 50+ LinkedIn posts about meeting room frustrations, reviewed Gartner reports on workplace management.
known_gaps: Limited data on companies under 200 employees
No direct observation of meeting booking behavior

job_to_be_done.trigger_situation: Employee needs to book a meeting room for an important client presentation or team sync
job_to_be_done.underlying_goal: Ensure productive meeting time without technical issues or room conflicts
job_to_be_done.success_definition: Meeting starts on time in an appropriately-sized room with working AV equipment

tools_and_workarounds: Booking rooms 'just in case' to ensure availability
Sending scouts to check room availability
Using personal phones to join remote meetings from different locations
Creating recurring blocks to reserve favorite rooms
current_behaviour.why_problem_persists: Existing solutions are reactive rather than predictive. No system optimizes for actual usage patterns.

pain_signals.description: Employees spend 15+ minutes per day searching for available meeting rooms
pain_signals.evidence_detail: Harvard Business Review study on workplace productivity (2024)
pain_signals.impact: Lost productivity valued at $2,000+ per employee annually

pain_signals.description: 30% of booked meeting rooms go unused due to no-shows
pain_signals.impact: Significant real estate waste and employee frustration

pain_signals.description: IT teams spend 8+ hours weekly troubleshooting meeting room AV issues
pain_signals.impact: IT resources diverted from strategic initiatives

uncomfortable_insights.insight: Many employees intentionally over-book rooms to game the system, making optimization culturally challenging
uncomfortable_insights.implication: Solution needs to address behavioral incentives, not just technology

what_customers_dont_care_about.assumed_need: Detailed analytics dashboards for space utilization
what_customers_dont_care_about.reality: Office managers want actionable recommendations, not more data to analyze

open_questions.question: What is the willingness to pay for AI-powered features vs basic booking?
